---
title: "Before the day"
---
The day is worked mainly in the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd), a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, with the data already in place, so there is nothing that you have to install. If you would rather work in an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), the downloadable workspace holds the same tasks and gives the same numbers, and it is yours to keep after the day; installing it is optional.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) | The original study and its design, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the question that each of them answered, how their results were put on one scale, and the replication with new data. Every part of the day works on this case. | 45 minutes |
| [Browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd) | Open it once on the machine and the browser that you will use, wait until the first cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run the setup cell of Task 1. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day. | 10 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Optional. Install R and an IDE, download the workspace zip and run `R/check_setup.R` until it prints OK. The [help page](../../help.qmd) has the problems that other participants have met. | 30 to 60 minutes, once |
| [Exercise overview](../../cases/housing/exercise.qmd) | Optional. The claim that you will be working on, the five tasks, and the table of what the five Multi100 analysts found when they reanalysed it. | 10 minutes |
| [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) | Optional. Worth the time if you have never written R: objects, data frames, reading a CSV file, the pipe and a first table, all on the housing-audit data. | An evening |

**By the start of the day** you have the browser lab loading on the machine that you will use, or the workspace working if you installed it, and you know what the claim is and how the five Multi100 analysts came to different conclusions about it.
